s3-welcome.speaker: Keelan
s3-welcome.text: Welcome back! Today we’re hunting for something brilliant: a thing that two friends both like.

s3-mission.speaker: Keelan
s3-mission.text: First, find the three glowing activity badges. They will power our Friendship Circle!

s3-badge-football.speaker: Keelan
s3-badge-football.text: Playing football! That one belongs to Leo.

s3-badge-reading.speaker: Keelan
s3-badge-reading.text: Reading funny stories! I can almost hear Sam laughing.

s3-badges-ready.speaker: Keelan
s3-badges-ready.text: Three badges found! The Friendship Circle is awake.

s3-choose-favourite.speaker: Keelan
s3-choose-favourite.text: Which activity do you like most? Choose with your heart, not with your homework brain.

s3-favourite-confirm.speaker: Keelan
s3-favourite-confirm.text: Great choice! Now let’s discover who likes it too.

s3-question-intro.speaker: Keelan
s3-question-intro.text: Our friendship question needs three parts: Do... you like... and the activity.

s3-question-reading.speaker: Keelan
s3-question-reading.text: Do you like reading funny stories?

s3-question-success.speaker: Keelan
s3-question-success.text: Yes! Do you like...? Your follow-up question is ready.

s3-record-question.speaker: Keelan
s3-record-question.text: Say your full question. Tap the microphone when you’re ready.

s3-recording-ready.speaker: Keelan
s3-recording-ready.text: Question captured! Listen back, keep it, or try once more.

s3-chats-intro.speaker: Keelan
s3-chats-intro.text: Ask Mia, Leo, and Sam in any order. Listen for yes, I do, or no, I don’t.

s3-ask-mia.speaker: Keelan
s3-ask-mia.text: Mia is ready. Ask your question!

s3-ask-leo.speaker: Keelan
s3-ask-leo.text: Leo is ready. Ask your question!

s3-ask-sam.speaker: Keelan
s3-ask-sam.text: Sam is ready. Ask your question!

s3-mia-painting-yes.speaker: Mia
s3-mia-painting-yes.text: Yes, I do! I love painting animals, especially cats.

s3-mia-football-no.speaker: Mia
s3-mia-football-no.text: No, I don’t, but I like the bright colours on football shirts.

s3-mia-reading-no.speaker: Mia
s3-mia-reading-no.text: No, I don’t read many funny stories, but they sound fun.

s3-leo-painting-no.speaker: Leo
s3-leo-painting-no.text: No, I don’t, but I can help choose a really cool animal.

s3-leo-football-yes.speaker: Leo
s3-leo-football-yes.text: Yes, I do! I love playing football with my friends.

s3-leo-reading-no.speaker: Leo
s3-leo-reading-no.text: No, I don’t read many stories, but funny ones could be good.

s3-sam-painting-no.speaker: Sam
s3-sam-painting-no.text: No, I don’t, but paintings can tell brilliant stories.

s3-sam-football-no.speaker: Sam
s3-sam-football-no.text: No, I don’t, but I would cheer for your team.

s3-sam-reading-yes.speaker: Sam
s3-sam-reading-yes.text: Yes, I do! Funny stories make me laugh so much.

s3-react-yes.speaker: Keelan
s3-react-yes.text: A yes answer! You can say: Me too!

s3-react-no.speaker: Keelan
s3-react-no.text: A no answer. That’s okay—friends can like different things.

s3-all-chats.speaker: Keelan
s3-all-chats.text: Three conversations complete! One friend shares your favourite.

s3-match-intro.speaker: Keelan
s3-match-intro.text: Who said yes to your favourite activity? Join the two matching badges.

s3-common-painting.speaker: Keelan
s3-common-painting.text: Mia and you both like painting animals. Say: We both like painting animals.

s3-common-football.speaker: Keelan
s3-common-football.text: Leo and you both like playing football. Say: We both like playing football.

s3-common-reading.speaker: Keelan
s3-common-reading.text: Sam and you both like reading funny stories. Say: We both like reading funny stories.

s3-record-common.speaker: Keelan
s3-record-common.text: Now record your common-ground sentence. Make the word both sparkle.

s3-common-ready.speaker: Keelan
s3-common-ready.text: You connected two people with one clear sentence. Friendship power!

s3-check-intro.speaker: Keelan
s3-check-intro.text: Three quick clues before the Friendship Circle opens. Ready?

s3-check-football.speaker: Keelan
s3-check-football.text: Who says yes to playing football: Mia, Leo, or Sam?

s3-check-negative.speaker: Keelan
s3-check-negative.text: Which answer means no: Yes, I do; No, I don’t; or Me too?

s3-check-shared.speaker: Keelan
s3-check-shared.text: Which sentence shows a shared interest: We both like reading; Sam likes reading; or Do you like reading?

s3-check-retry.speaker: Keelan
s3-check-retry.text: Almost! Use the picture clue and listen once more.

s3-check-correct.speaker: Keelan
s3-check-correct.text: That’s the one! Common-ground clue collected.

s3-check-complete.speaker: Keelan
s3-check-complete.text: Three clues collected! The Friendship Circle is shining.

s3-reflect.speaker: Keelan
s3-reflect.text: Which friendship power helped most: asking, listening, or connecting?

s3-complete.speaker: Keelan
s3-complete.text: Mission complete! You asked a follow-up question, understood yes and no, and found something in common.

s3-practice-invite.speaker: Keelan
s3-practice-invite.text: Take your Friendship Circle into the practice games and power up both, do, and don’t.
